properties.name: --lr-positioning-strategy
properties.description:
**`<lr-app-rail-item>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the icon-only flyout tooltip's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-citation-badge>`, `<lr-entity-chip>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the preview popover's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-color-picker>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, read from computed style when the panel is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-combobox>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}, read from computed style when the listbox is positioned.

**`<lr-date-input>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the calendar popup's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-dropdown>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, inherited from the popover surface.

**`<lr-export-button>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the format menu's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-locale-picker>`, `<lr-mention-popover>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the listbox's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-menu>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the private submenu surface's `fixed` default, read from computed style when a submenu is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-model-select>`, `<lr-voice-picker>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the listbox; the default is `fixed` when no recognized ancestor value is set.

**`<lr-navigation-menu>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override read by the items when their panels are positioned.

**`<lr-navigation-menu-item>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override read when the panel is positioned.

**`<lr-popover>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}, read from computed style when the popup is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-select>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, read from computed style when the listbox is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-time-input>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the column picker's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-tool-call-chip>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the detail tooltip's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-tooltip>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, read from computed style when the bubble is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-tour>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the step popover's `fixed` default, read from computed style when a step is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-usage-badge>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the breakdown tooltip's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

properties.name: --lr-theme-scrollbar-gutter
properties.description:
**`<lr-code-block>`, `<lr-code-block-core>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by `body`; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-code-editor>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the `editor` scroll frame; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-table>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the `base` scroll container; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-virtual-list>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the `base` scroll viewport; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

properties.name: --lr-theme-scrollbar-width
properties.description:
**`<lr-code-block>`, `<lr-code-block-core>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar width honored by `body`; unset, renders identically to before.

**`<lr-code-editor>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar width honored by the `editor` scroll frame; unset, renders identically to before.

**`<lr-table>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar width honored by the `base` scroll container; unset, renders identically to before.

**`<lr-virtual-list>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar width honored by the `base` scroll viewport; unset, renders identically to before.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface)`) — Fill of the outer card (`[part="base"]`) while `frame="card"`. `frame="plain"` still removes the fill entirely.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Outline color of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-offset
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `calc(-1 * var(--lr-focus-ring-offset))`) — Inward offset of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`, keeping the outline inside its own scrollport so it is not clipped at the edge.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-style
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `solid`) — Outline style of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-width
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-focus-ring-width)`) — Outline width of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Colour of the outer card's border and of the header/body divider, which `frame="plain"` keeps.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-body-font-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-size-sm)`) — Font size of `[part="body"]` while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-body-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-s)`) — `[part="body"]` padding while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-header-font-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-size-sm)`) — Font size of `[part="header"]` while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-header-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs)`) — Gap between the header toggle, label, and duration while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-header-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs) var(--lr-space-s)`) — `[part="header"]` padding while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-max-block-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-16rem)`) — Cap on how tall the expanded reasoning transcript grows before `[part="body"]` scrolls internally.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-pending-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Live pending-state color.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius)`) — Corner radius of the outer card. `frame="plain"` still squares the corners.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning-quiet)`) — Background of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `currentColor`) — Foreground of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `0`) — Padding of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius-xs)`) — Corner radius of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `color-mix(in oklab, var(--lr-thread-list-group-toggle-hover-bg, var(--lr-color-surface-raised)), var(--lr-color-mix-partner) var(--lr-color-mix-active))`) — Group-toggle pressed background.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-active-color

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-hover-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface-raised)`) — Group-toggle hover background.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Group-toggle hover foreground.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-active-bg

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-icon-button-color-active, var(--lr-thread-list-row-action-hover-color, var(--lr-icon-button-color-hover, var(--lr-color-text))))`) — Row-action pressed foreground.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-hover-bg

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-icon-button-color-hover, var(--lr-color-text))`) — Row-action hover foreground.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-clear-size

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-font-size

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-xs)`) — Gap between the search field and its clear button.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-min-height
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** — Minimum row height of the search field.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-s)`) — Gutter around the built-in search field.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-padding-block
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-xs)`) — Block gutter of the search field.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-padding-inline

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius)`) — Corner radius of the search field.
